title: Studio at 1024 px: the read-only app chip, the flow item header and the Access tabs truncate or wrap
body:
## Source

Measured on objectui main `8415d9f11` in a 1024 × 768 pane (en) and re-checked at 1280 × 900 (zh), HotCRM open:

1. Data pillar: the shell header's app chip reads "Hot… 🔒 Read-only ▾" — the lock and the Read-only label (objectui#12453) take the chip's width and the name truncates to three letters. At 1280 the name is whole.
2. Automations pillar: the item header reads "Enroll Memb…" and the meta "Trigger: screen · Status: (" is cut mid-word; the "Read-only · Customize with an overlay" chip at the right truncates to "Read-onl…". At 1280 the title, meta and chip are whole.
3. Access pillar: the five tab labels wrap to two lines ("System capabilities", "Row-level security", "Tab visibility", "Delegated admin"), the tab row is 60 px instead of 36; at 1280 in zh the labels are short and the row is 36 px.
4. Interfaces pillar: with the aside folded into a "Canvas / Properties" toggle (objectui#11795), the dashboard's KPI cards read "Total … Total Amount" and "Active A… Accounts"; nothing says the properties aside moved into the toggle.

## Target

1. The app chip truncates in this order: the Read-only label first (lock stays), then the name with a 120 px minimum; the full name and the posture are in the chip's tooltip.
2. The item header hides the meta slot first (below 1100 px content width), then the status chip's text (icon stays, text in tooltip), and truncates the title last; the title keeps at least 200 px.
3. The tab row never wraps: `white-space: nowrap`, horizontal scroll with faded edges when the tabs exceed the row; the active tab scrolls into view.
4. When the aside folds, the toggle's "Properties" segment carries a dot while the aside has content, and the folded canvas keeps a 16 px gutter so KPI cards get their min-width.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (shell header chip, `StudioItemHeader` usage), `StudioItemHeader.tsx` (meta / chip folding), `studio-tokens.ts` (tab row), the Interfaces pillar's folded layout, tests beside each.

## Acceptance

1. Tests at a 1024 px jsdom width: the chip's visible text starts with "HotCRM"; the item header's title has no ellipsis for a 26-character title; the tab row has one line.
2. Screenshots at 1024 and 1280 px of the four pillars, light and dark.
3. `StudioDesignSurface.*.test.tsx` and the pillar tests green.

## Constraints

- objectui#11795's fold width and objectui#12453's read-only signals stay; only their narrow-width rendering changes.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `01244b886`, never merged): [studio-1024-data-app-chip-truncated.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/01244b886/docs/design/setup-review-2026-10-16/studio-1024-data-app-chip-truncated.jpg?raw=true) · [studio-1024-automations-header-truncated.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/01244b886/docs/design/setup-review-2026-10-16/studio-1024-automations-header-truncated.jpg?raw=true) · [studio-1024-access-tabs-wrap.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/01244b886/docs/design/setup-review-2026-10-16/studio-1024-access-tabs-wrap.jpg?raw=true) · [studio-1024-interfaces-kpi-truncated.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/01244b886/docs/design/setup-review-2026-10-16/studio-1024-interfaces-kpi-truncated.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 second review pass: objectui main `8415d9f11`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, the Studio pillars and all 43 Setup pages walked in the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (en) with a 1280 × 900 re-check (zh). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed, verbatim: 「全部立卡」.</sub>
